title: Negative: hand-drawn sighting map, Fall Creek, E 56th St bridge, woods and path of object
description: White-on-black negative photostat of a hand-drawn location map with a north arrow and struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps. Labels include "E 56th St", "Fall Creek Blvd", "Fall Creek", "Woods", "Clearing", "Cantilever Type Bridge" and "Path of Object", with an arrow marking the object's route near the bridge. A box at lower right reads "Lady wood School (Approx 1/4 mi f/sighting"; the map is signed by a USAF 1st Lt., Intel Officer.
